title: The unramified source locus for algebraic spaces and arbitrary base change
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a locally finite type morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$. There exists a largest open subspace $U(f)\subseteq X$ on which $f$ is unramified. Its underlying set is exactly the points where $f$ is unramified. For every morphism of algebraic spaces $h:Y^\prime\to Y$, with $f^\prime:X^\prime=X\times_Y Y^\prime\to Y^\prime$ and projection $p:X^\prime\to X$, one has $U(f^\prime)=X^\prime\times_X U(f)$ as open subspaces of $X^\prime$. Algebraic spaces and their morphisms use [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Their fibre products and point sets $|X|$ (field-valued points up to common field extension) use [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Locally of finite type and unramified for algebraic spaces are tested etale locally on source and target with [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-unramified-morphism]. An open subspace is an inclusion whose every scheme base change is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. A morphism is unramified at a point if some open neighbourhood of that point has unramified restriction.

source.place: Tag 05W2 (lemma-where-unramified), specialized to Z=Y; the open locus is maximal by the definition of unramified at a point.

proof.text: Choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $b:V\to Y$ using [def-trf-algebraic-space]. By [lem-sfb-unramified-etale-compatible-charts], choose a compatible scheme chart $a:A\to X$, surjective etale, and $g:A\to V$ with $bg=fa$. The local finite type hypothesis on $f$, tested on these charts as in the statement, makes $g$ locally of finite type. Let $T\subseteq A$ be the union of all open subschemes on which $g$ is unramified. This is the open $W_g$ in [lem-trf-unramified-locus-base-change].

source.place: Tag 05W2 (lemma-where-unramified), compatible scheme presentations and the set T; Tags 02X1, 03MJ, 0475.

proof.text: The restriction $g|_T$ is unramified. Indeed cover $T$ by the opens $O$ in its defining union. Local finite type is local on the source directly from its affine-cover definition [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Each $O\times_V O$ is an open subscheme of $T\times_V T$, and the diagonal of $O\to V$ is an open immersion. Their images are open in $T\times_V T$ and their union is the image of $\Delta_{T/V}$. On these opens the diagonal identifies the structure sheaves, so it is an open immersion by [def-weil-open-immersion]. Thus the diagonal definition [def-weil-unramified-morphism] proves the claim. This also covers $T=\varnothing$.

source.place: Tag 03ZK (lemma-unramified-local), source-locality in clause (9); scheme diagonal criterion Tag 02GE.

proof.text: The map $T\to X$ is representable etale: restriction of $a$ to an open is etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] on scheme tests. Apply [lem-a1-space-etale-open-image] to obtain its image open subspace $I\subseteq X$ and a surjective etale map $T\to I$. The compatible diagram $T\to V$ over $I\to Y$ now tests unramifiedness by [lem-sfb-unramified-etale-compatible-charts]. Step 2 gives its top arrow unramified, hence $f|_I$ is unramified.

source.place: Tag 05W2, the unramified open is the image of T; Tag 06NF (lemma-etale-image-open) and chart locality Tag 03MJ.

proof.text: For every open subspace $N\subseteq X$ on which $f$ is unramified, the pullback $A_N=A\times_XN$ is an open subscheme of $A$ with point set $|a|^{-1}(|N|)$ by [lem-a1-space-open-factor-scheme-tests]. Chart locality [lem-sfb-unramified-etale-compatible-charts] applied to $A_N\to V$ over $N\to Y$ makes $g|_{A_N}$ unramified. Therefore $A_N\subseteq T$. Surjectivity of $a$ implies $|N|\subseteq |a|(|T|)=|I|$, and the order comparison [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] gives $N\subseteq I$. Step 3 proves $I$ itself works, so $I=U(f)$ is largest. By the definition of unramified at a point, its points are exactly the required locus. Taking $N=I$ also proves $|a|^{-1}(|I|)=|T|$: one inclusion is $A_I\subseteq T$ just proved, and the reverse follows since $a(T)\subseteq I$.

source.place: Tag 05W2 with Definition 03ZH (definition-unramified), maximality and the saturated inverse image of the locus.

proof.text: Let $h:Y'\to Y$ be arbitrary and form $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Every scheme base change of $f$ is an algebraic space by that same result, so $f$ is representable by algebraic spaces as a stack morphism. Hence [lem-sfb-stack-chartwise-smooth-etale-calculus] gives local finite type of $f':X'\to Y'$. Choose a surjective etale scheme atlas $V'\to V\times_Y Y'$. Put $A'=A\times_V V'$, a scheme since $A,V,V'$ are schemes. The map $V'\to Y'$ is surjective etale. Also $A'\to A\times_Y Y'$ is a pullback of $V'\to V\times_Y Y'$, and $A\times_Y Y'\to X'$ is the pullback of $a$. Thus $a':A'\to X'$ is surjective etale by base change and composition [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers, lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence]. This supplies a compatible chart diagram for $f'$ whose top arrow is exactly $g':A'=A\times_V V'\to V'$.

source.place: Tag 05W2, construction of compatible base-changed charts, specialized to Z=Y; Tag 03XH for local finite type.

proof.text:
Write $r:A'\to A$. By [lem-trf-unramified-locus-base-change] applied to the locally finite type scheme map $g$, its unramified open satisfies $|T'|=|r|^{-1}(|T|)$. Apply steps 1--4 to the compatible charts $A'\to V'$ of $f'$, giving $I'=U(f')$ and $|a'|^{-1}(|I'|)=|T'|$. The saturation identity of step 4 for $f$, and $ar=pa'$, give
$$|T'|=|r|^{-1}|a|^{-1}(|I|)=|a'|^{-1}|p|^{-1}(|I|).$$
Since $|a'|$ is surjective, comparison with its inverse image of $|I'|$ proves $|I'|=|p|^{-1}(|I|)$. By [lem-a1-space-open-factor-scheme-tests], $X'\times_X I$ is an open subspace with precisely this point set. The order comparison in [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] in both directions therefore yields $U(f')=X'\times_XU(f)$ as open subfunctors, not just as point sets.

lean.statement: theorem exists_unramified_open_baseChange {S : Scheme.{u}} (X Y : AlgebraicSpace S) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : MapIsLocally (@LocallyOfFiniteType) f) : ∃ (U : AlgebraicSpace S) (j : U ⟶ X), IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ q ↦ IsOpenImmersion q.left) j.hom.hom ∧ MapIsLocally (@AlgebraicGeometry.IsUnramified) (j ≫ f) ∧ (∀ (V : AlgebraicSpace S) (i : V ⟶ X), IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ q ↦ IsOpenImmersion q.left) i.hom.hom → MapIsLocally (@AlgebraicGeometry.IsUnramified) (i ≫ f) → Subfunctor.range i.hom.hom ≤ Subfunctor.range j.hom.hom) ∧ (∀ x : Point X.obj.obj, x ∈ pointImage j.hom.hom ↔ ∃ (V : AlgebraicSpace S) (i : V ⟶ X), IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ q ↦ IsOpenImmersion q.left) i.hom.hom ∧ MapIsLocally (@AlgebraicGeometry.IsUnramified) (i ≫ f) ∧ x ∈ pointImage i.hom.hom) ∧ (∀ (Y' : AlgebraicSpace S) (h : Y' ⟶ Y) (X' : AlgebraicSpace S) (p : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y'), IsPullback p.hom f'.hom f.hom h.hom → ∃ (U' : AlgebraicSpace S) (j' : U' ⟶ X'), IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ q ↦ IsOpenImmersion q.left) j'.hom.hom ∧ MapIsLocally (@AlgebraicGeometry.IsUnramified) (j' ≫ f') ∧ (∀ (V : AlgebraicSpace S) (i : V ⟶ X'), IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ q ↦ IsOpenImmersion q.left) i.hom.hom → MapIsLocally (@AlgebraicGeometry.IsUnramified) (i ≫ f') → Subfunctor.range i.hom.hom ≤ Subfunctor.range j'.hom.hom) ∧ Subfunctor.range j'.hom.hom = (Subfunctor.range j.hom.hom).preimage p.hom.hom)
